job.title: Head Service Quality, Resolution & Enablement
job.description:
The VP, Head of Service Quality, Resolution & Enablement is responsible for leading and continuously improving service quality, customer issue resolution, and enablement capabilities across the organization, ensuring a consistent, high-quality customer experience. The role oversees service standards, complaint and escalation management, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives, while driving governance, policies, tools, and training to enhance frontline and support team effectiveness. Working closely with senior stakeholders, the position ensures regulatory compliance, operational excellence, data-driven decision-making, and alignment with the organization’s customer excellence strategy and business objectives.

Key Relationships

Internal: Digital & Tech, Operations, Business Lines, Branches, Contact Centre, Risk, Compliance, Data & Analytics, HR.
External: Platform vendors, consultants, regulators.

Qualifications & Experience

Education: Minimum Bachelor’s degree.
Experience:

  • 12–15 years in service quality, complaints/resolution, or customer platform governance (banking/regulatory industries).

  • Proven experience as business owner for customer platforms.

  • Track record in leading resolution functions and delivering customer outcomes.

  • Experience in service quality frameworks across multiple channels.

Technical Competencies:

  • CRM/CC platforms (Genesys, Avaya, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics).

  • Customer platform governance.

  • Complaints/escalation management.

  • Service quality assessment/benchmarking.

  • AI/analytics in quality measurement.

  • Knowledge of service standards, journeys, customer lifecycle management, CPR requirements.

Behavioral Competencies:

  • Decisive, analytical, collaborative, customer-centric.

Leadership Competencies:

  • Lead multi-discipline function (platforms, resolution, quality).

  • Strong influencing skills with senior stakeholders.

job.title: Head of Infrastructure and Security Operations
job.description:
Head of Infrastructure & Security Operations | Dubai, UAE

 

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced and strategic leader to drive Infrastructure and Security Operations. This senior role is responsible for ensuring secure, reliable, and cost-effective IT services across the organization. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in infrastructure architecture, cloud platforms, and security operations, along with a proven track record of leading high-performing IT teams.

 

Key Responsibilities: Infrastructure Operations:
  • Lead enterprise infrastructure services, including data centers, cloud platforms, networks, storage, backup, and endpoint management.
  • Ensure availability, performance, and scalability of IT systems supporting business-critical applications.
  • Manage infrastructure projects, upgrades, and integrations aligned with IT strategy.
  • Oversee desktop support and helpdesk operations.
  • Drive automation and modernization initiatives to improve efficiency and reliability.
  • Optimize cloud (OCI, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premise environments for cost and performance.

 

Security Operations Oversight:
  • Lead the Security Operations Center (SOC) with 24×7 monitoring, incident detection, and response.
  • Oversee SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, DLP, vulnerability, and patch-management programs.
  • Coordinate incident response and disaster recovery readiness.
  • Ensure compliance with security governance policies and collaborate on audits.

 

Leadership & Vendor Management:
  • Manage vendor and service-provider relationships to ensure SLA adherence and high performance.
  • Lead and mentor infrastructure and SOC teams, fostering operational excellence.
  • Collaborate across IT and business teams to integrate security and infrastructure strategies.

 

Reporting & Governance:
  • Define and monitor KPIs and operational metrics for infrastructure and security.
  • Report on infrastructure health, incidents, and vulnerabilities to executive leadership.
  • Support audit and compliance activities as part of enterprise governance frameworks.

 

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, or related field.
  • ITIL certification (Manager/Expert preferred).
  • Cloud certifications (Azure, AWS, Oracle) are a plus.
  • Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or GIAC preferred.
  • 12–15 years of IT infrastructure and operations experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Proven expertise in cloud infrastructure, networks, virtualization, and system administration.
  • Experience managing SOC teams and enterprise security operations.
  • Strong background in vendor management, hybrid cloud, and enterprise security frameworks.

 

Skills & Competencies:
  • Strategic and analytical thinking
  • Strong leadership and communication skills
  • Deep technical understanding of IT infrastructure and security tools
  • Ability to manage large, complex projects and teams
  • Collaborative mindset with a focus on operational excellence

 

Why This Role:

This is a unique opportunity to lead enterprise-wide IT infrastructure and security operations in a dynamic, growth-oriented organization, shaping the technology strategy and driving operational resilience at scale.

 

 

*Due to the high volume of applications we are receiving, we kindly request that only candidates who meet all the required qualifications apply. This helps us ensure a faster and more focused recruitment process.*
